# MDN051 `superfluous-save`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

`save` in a module specification part.

## Why

Module variables are saved implicitly since Fortran 2008: the `save` adds nothing.

## Reported

```fortran
module state
  real, save :: t
```

## Preferred

```fortran
module state
  real :: t
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN051] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN051` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD051` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
